ACTION: Dispatch a scoped re-review on model `sonnet`, using `re-review-prompt.md`. The diff is small and docs-only, so the standard tier is enough. The prompt gives the diff file path and the text of F1 as the reviewer wrote it. It asks for ADDRESSED or NOT ADDRESSED on F1, and for any new Critical or Important issue.

I do not mark Task 3 complete in the ledger until the re-review comes back clean.

---

I am fixing F1 myself. F1 is the reviewer's one Important finding: `docs/sync.md:12` says `--dry_run`, but the code, help text and tests use `--dry-run`. The fix is a one-file docs change with no behavior change. A scoped re-review follows the commit.

`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
- The skill lets the controller fix a wrong name in docs directly. A fix subagent would cost more and add context to the controller for no gain. Any change to what code does still goes to a subagent.
- The re-review still runs. No test reads `docs/sync.md`, so the reviewer is the only check that the doc now matches the flag.
